_about: Public-domain John Brine (1703-1765, Particular Baptist, Currier's Hall, London) for the Word Hoard: A Treatise on Various Subjects (1766), The Certain Efficacy of the Death of Christ (catalogued 1743), A Vindication of Some Truths of Natural and Revealed Religion (1746), The True Sense of Atonement (catalogued 1752), A Defence of the Doctrine of Eternal Justification (catalogued 1732), Motives to Love and Unity among Calvinists (catalogued 1753) and A Discourse on the Prayer of Jabez (1736), raw Internet Archive OCR, most of it 18th-century long-s type. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 17 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

brine-treatise-1766: A Treatise on Various Subjects (London: George Keith, MDCCLXVI)
brine-certain-efficacy: The Certain Efficacy of the Death of Christ, Asserted (London: Aaron Ward; title-page year garbled, catalogued 1743)
brine-vindication-1746: A Vindication of Some Truths of Natural and Revealed Religion (London: Aaron Ward, MDCCXLVI)
brine-true-sense-atonement: The True Sense of Atonement for Sin, by Christ's Death (London: John Ward; catalogued 1752)
brine-eternal-justification: A Defence of the Doctrine of Eternal Justification (London: A. Ward; catalogued 1732)
brine-motives-love-unity: Motives to Love and Unity among Calvinists (London: John Ward; catalogued 1753)
brine-jabez-1736: A Discourse on the Prayer of Jabez (London: Aaron Ward, M.DCC.XXXVI)
